summary: Hand of Yahweh upon me brought me out in Yahweh's Spirit set me down in middle of valley full of bones, very many on surface of valley and behold very dry, said to me son of man can these bones live? I answered Lord Yahweh you know. He said prophesy to bones hear word of Yahweh, behold I will cause breath to enter and you shall live, lay sinews upon you bring flesh skin, put breath and you shall live and know I am Yahweh. So I prophesied as commanded, there was noise and behold earthquake, bones came together bone to bone, sinews flesh skin, but no breath in them. Then says prophesy to wind come from four winds O breath breathe upon slain that they may live, I prophesied, breath came into them lived stood upon feet exceeding great army. Then he said son of man these bones are whole house of Israel behold they say our bones are dried our hope perished cut off, therefore prophesy Behold I will open your graves and cause you to come up out of graves my people and bring you into land of Israel and put my Spirit within you and you shall live and know I am Yahweh. And word came saying take one stick write for Judah and children of Israel his companions, another stick for Joseph stick of Ephraim and all house Israel companions, join them one to another into one stick and they shall become one in your hand, say I will take children of Israel from among nations gather, make them one nation, one king shall be king to them all, David my servant shall be king, they shall dwell in land forever.
whyItMatters: Valley of dry bones — most famous vision of resurrection and national restoration, plus two sticks becoming one — Judah and Joseph reunited under one king David forever.

keyVerses.text: He said to me, “Son of man, can these bones live?” I answered, “Lord Yahweh, you know.”
keyVerses.why: Question — can these bones live? You know, not I.

keyVerses.text: Then he said to me, “Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Behold, they say, ‘Our bones are dried up, and our hope is lost. We are completely cut off.’
keyVerses.why: Interpretation — bones are whole house Israel saying hope perished, God will open graves.

keyVerses.text: I will put my Spirit in you, and you will live. Then I will place you in your own land; and you will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken it and performed it,” says Yahweh.’”
keyVerses.why: Spirit within and land — resurrection and return.

questions.question: What does valley of dry bones represent? Literal resurrection?
questions.answer: Vision is symbolic: bones are whole house of Israel saying our bones dried and hope perished we are cut off (v11) — exiles feel dead, no hope. Dry means long dead, hopeless. God asks can these bones live? — impossible humanly. Prophecy to bones brings noise, earthquake, bones together, sinews flesh skin but no breath — reconstruction without life. Then prophesy to breath (ruach can be wind, breath, Spirit) from four winds breathe, breath enters live stand exceeding great army. Then interpretation: I will open graves and bring into land and put my Spirit within you. So meaning is national restoration from exile as resurrection, but also points to ultimate resurrection and new life by Spirit. Jewish and Christian tradition sees both historical return and future resurrection.

questions.question: What about two sticks Judah and Joseph becoming one?
questions.answer: Second sign: take one stick write for Judah and children of Israel his companions, another for Joseph stick of Ephraim and all house Israel companions, join one stick they become one in hand. Interpretation: I will take Israel from among nations gather, make one nation in land, one king shall be king, no longer two nations divided, David my servant shall be king forever, covenant of peace everlasting. After kingdom divided 930 BC into Judah south and Israel/Ephraim north, and north exiled 722 BC, vision hopes reunification under Davidic king forever — messianic hope of united people.
